# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh readback and stability fixes** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and fixes a SkSL raster code-generation lifetime error.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Readbacks respect failed GPU work** — Prevents stale readback after failed flushes and restores MSAA/mipmap dirty tracking when resolve tasks do not execute. Includes further failed-flush handling and an Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion correction. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **SkSL raster code-generation lifetime** — Includes the upstream RasterPipeline code-generation use-after-free correction. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## Engine

- **Additional m150 servicing** — Incorporates the same-milestone upstream servicing sync without changing the managed API or C API surface. ([#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
